subject: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping (Netflix)
title: Is Toos a true story? Yes — the real 1982 Van der Valk kidnapping
answer: Yes. Netflix's Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping, out Nov. 26, 2026, is a drama inspired by the real kidnapping of Toos van der Valk, matriarch of the Dutch Van der Valk hotel family. She was taken on Nov. 26, 1982, held for 21 days and released on Dec. 17, 1982, after a ransom was paid. The series is a dramatization, not a documentary.
body:
Toos van der Valk (born Anthonia van de Cappelle in Delft in 1930) married Gerrit van der Valk, son of the founders of Van der Valk, now one of the Netherlands' best-known hotel and restaurant chains. The couple ran a restaurant in Vught and in 1968 opened a motel in Nuland, in the south of the country, and raised seven children.

On Nov. 26, 1982, she was kidnapped. According to the family's own account, she was held in Belgium for 21 days before being released on Dec. 17, 1982, once a ransom had been paid; just after her release she knocked on a stranger's door for help. The case gripped the Netherlands, which a year later was shaken again by the kidnapping of beer magnate Freddy Heineken. Toos van der Valk told her own story in the 2011 book Mijn ontvoering (My Kidnapping), written with Elle van Rijn. The family says she is still alive and doing well.

The Netflix series premieres Nov. 26, 2026 — 44 years to the day after the kidnapping. It is a six-episode Dutch-language drama directed by Inti Calfat and Dirk Verheye, with Lies Visschedijk as Toos and Frank Lammers as her husband, Gerrit. According to the series' synopsis, it follows the family's crisis, the press frenzy and the authorities' fear that paying a ransom would set a precedent.

What is changed: the makers describe the series as inspired by real events, and Van der Valk's own news site says the drama alters or adds characters and scenes. The family's website states it is independent of Netflix and the series. For what actually happened, the family's account and the 2011 book are the primary sources.
in_the_news: Netflix releases Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping on Nov. 26, 2026, the 44th anniversary of the real kidnapping.

faq.q: Is Toos van der Valk still alive?
faq.a: Yes. The family's website, updated in fall 2026, says she is doing well. She was born on Dec. 22, 1930.

faq.q: How long was Toos van der Valk kidnapped?
faq.a: 21 days, from Nov. 26 to Dec. 17, 1982. She was held in Belgium and released after a ransom was paid.

faq.q: When does Toos come out on Netflix?
faq.a: Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026. It is a six-episode Dutch-language series.

faq.q: Who plays Toos van der Valk?
faq.a: Dutch actress Lies Visschedijk. Frank Lammers plays her husband, Gerrit van der Valk.
